description: Combine image files into a new document with one of Photoshop's multi-file commands, without its dialog: stack (File > Scripts > Load Files into Stack), photomerge (File > Automate > Photomerge panorama), hdr (File > Automate > Merge to HDR Pro, with its last-used settings) or statistics (File > Scripts > Statistics stack mode). Large merges can outlast the script timeout

align.description: stack, hdr, statistics: auto-align the layers. Default false (hdr: true)

blend.description: photomerge: Blend Images Together. Default true

distortionCorrection.description: photomerge: Geometric Distortion Correction. Default false

files.description: Absolute paths of two or more images

fillTransparent.description: photomerge: Content Aware Fill Transparent Areas. Default false

layout.description: photomerge: Auto (default), Perspective, Cylindrical, Spherical, Collage or Reposition

smartObject.description: stack: convert the stack into a smart object. Default false

statistic.description: statistics: the stack mode. Default median

name: combine_images
title: Combine Images
